description: crl.rs lines 73-91: the struct-level doc comment for CrlChecker has a Limitations section where the first bullet (line 74) has an extra leading space (' /// -') while all other bullets use the standard '/// -' prefix without the leading space. This causes rustdoc to render the first limitation item outside the bullet list, appearing as a separate paragraph. It's a cosmetic but visible doc rendering bug. Suggested fix: remove the extra leading space on line 74 to align with the other bullet items.
title: P3: CRL doc comment: indentation/formatting inconsistency in Limitations
